title: Uldolmok: The Fleet Stopped by Thirteen Ships
summary: Tells how the Korean admiral Yi Sun-sin, stripped of rank on a slander and put to torture in fifteen ninety-seven, held off hundreds of Japanese ships in the Uldolmok Strait with the thirteen vessels left after the fleet was destroyed at Chilcheollyang. The episode covers how the strait's tidal current was turned into a weapon, and the last order the admiral gave a year later at Noryang.
